description: Mozambique: Cyclone Chido Multi-Sectoral Initial Rapid Assessment is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Mozambique. Cyclone Chido Multip-Sectoral Initial Rapid Assessment(MIRA) analysis dataset of Cabo Delgado and Nampula, Mozambique. On December 15, 2024, Tropical Cyclone Chido made landfall in Mozambique, bringing torrential rainfall of up to 250 mm in 24 hours and winds reaching speeds of 120 km/h. Coverage: Mozambique. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Mozambique. Its tags are affected area, disability, gender and age disaggregated data-gadd, natural disasters, needs assessment. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2026-07-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
